author: tbenr
content: I know it might be controversial but I believe there is a third way by having a 5820 with signature in is an option that reduces the blast radius and removes RLP\EL fork dependency. We could remove signature later if turns out that is actually not used (we have doubts over it).

content: and flows remain the same
